say:0:1321501001:0.text: Is that Gali and Melissa over there?
say:0:1321501001:0.source_cn: 前面的两个人好像是伽利和梅丽莎！

say:1:1321501002:0.text: Hmmm, what are they arguing about this time?
say:1:1321501002:0.source_cn: 唔，他们又在争论个不停呢……

say:3:1321503001:1.text: Hey, Gali! Hey, Melissa! Long time no see!

say:4:1321503002:1.text: Are you alright, Gali? You seem all sneezy.
say:4:1321503002:1.source_cn: 不过伽利你还好吗？满满隔着很远都听到你在打喷嚏。

say:5:1321503003:2.text: I-I'm fine. Just a little bit of... A-CHOO... pollen allergy.
say:5:1321503003:2.source_cn: 还……阿嚏……还吼，只是轻微的发粉——阿嚏！发粉过敏……

say:6:1321503004:1.text: A little? Your face is so puffy you look like a chipmunk hoarding nuts! Even I can barely understand you, and we've worked together for years.
say:6:1321503004:1.source_cn: 这可不是轻微的花粉过敏！！你的脸都肿成嘴里塞满坚果的仓...

say:7:1321503005:1.text: Seriously, you need to rest before it gets worse. Let's head back to Cedartown!
say:7:1321503005:1.source_cn: 别再硬撑了，还是先回雪松镇休息吧！

say:8:1321503006:1.text: No, I can't leave just yet! There's got to be an ancient tomb here. I just need to... A...Achoo... find it!
say:8:1321503006:1.source_cn: 不行！这片发海里肯定有古代墓穴，考擦完才能——阿嚏！！

choice_prompt:9:1321503006.text: No, I can't leave just yet! There's got to be an ancient tomb here. I just need to... A...Achoo... find it!
choice_prompt:9:1321503006.source_cn: 不行！这片发海里肯定有古代墓穴，考擦完才能——阿嚏！！

say:12:1321503007:1.text: Exactly! How can you be so certain there's a tomb here? What if you're wrong? This isn't worth it!
say:12:1321503007:1.source_cn: 是呀。而且你怎么能确定繁花原野一定有古代墓穴呢？万一没...

say:13:1321503008:2.text: A... Achoo! I-I can't be wrong! A... Achoo!
say:13:1321503008:2.source_cn: 不，我能确定！这里一定……阿、阿嚏！

say:15:1321503011:2.text: The conservatory gave us some time off. We were going to relax and enjoy the Snowspire Festival, but instead, we stumbled upon an antique bracelet in Cedartown.
say:15:1321503011:2.source_cn: 最近学会给我和伽利放了假，我们原本想趁这个机会好好体验...

say:16:1321503012:2.text: It didn't look like much—rusty and unremarkable—but after Gali examined it, he determined it to be at least a thousand years old. Judging from its style, it might have belonged to a noble or a high-ranking knight.
say:16:1321503012:2.source_cn: 虽然那件手环看上去锈迹斑斑的，一点也不起眼，但经过伽利...

say:17:1321503013:1.text: The merchant mentioned that they live near the Petalia Plains and often unearth artifacts. This bracelet, too, was found by their family. So, Gali is convinced there's an ancient tomb hidden somewhere here.
say:17:1321503013:1.source_cn: 卖它的人说他就住在花海附近，时不时就会在地里翻出一些旧...

say:18:1321503014:2.text: You know how he is—he'd rather skip the festival entirely than miss a chance to investigate! There goes my peaceful vacation...
say:18:1321503014:2.source_cn: 你们也知道他的性格，宁可不参加祭典也非要过来考察！只可...

say:21:1321503015:2.text: Ah, so that's why he's so insistent!
say:21:1321503015:2.source_cn: 原来如此，难怪伽利这么坚持！

say:24:1321503016:2.text: But Gali, even if there's an ancient tomb here, it's not worth risking your health over allergies.
say:24:1321503016:2.source_cn: 可就算确定这里有古代墓穴，伽利你也没必要冒着过敏的风险...

say:25:1321503017:1.text: I've never had... achoo... allergies before!
say:25:1321503017:1.source_cn: 我以前从不……从不过敏……阿嚏！

say:26:1321503018:2.text: Hmm, he's telling the truth. Why's it hitting him so badly this time?
say:26:1321503018:2.source_cn: 可不是吗。伽利从来没出现过花粉过敏的情况，连声喷嚏也没...

say:27:1321503019:1.text: I keep telling him to rest and come back next time, but he's just not having it.
say:27:1321503019:1.source_cn: 我一直劝他暂停考察计划，先回去休息，可他就是不听。

say:28:1321503020:1.text: Every moment we delay risks damage to the tomb! A little allergy is nothing... ACHOO!
say:28:1321503020:1.source_cn: 晚一天考察，墓穴就多一分被破坏的可能性！过敏算得了什…...

say:29:1321503021:2.text: Then you should cover your nose and mouth...

say:30:1321503022:1.text: *Sigh* If only we had some kind of <style="highlight">magic cure for allergies</style>. Too bad Cedartown doesn't have anything like that.

say:31:1321503023:2.text: Actually, I've got a recipe for a potion that might help. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, shall we try it out for him?
say:31:1321503023:2.source_cn: 唔，我这里倒是有类似的药剂配方。<style=stre...
say:31:1321503023:2.male: Actually, I've got a recipe for a potion that might help. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, shall we try it out for him?
say:31:1321503023:2.female: Actually, I've got a recipe for a potion that might help. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, shall we try it out for him?

choice:9:0:1.text: C'mon, your health is more important.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 身体要紧，还是回去休息吧
choice:9:0:1.male: C'mon, your health is more important.
choice:9:0:1.female: C'mon, your health is more important.

say:34:1321503009:2.source_cn: 有人在这里捡到……阿、阿嚏！

choice:9:1:2.text: And how exactly do you know that?
choice:9:1:2.male: And how exactly do you know that?
choice:9:1:2.female: And how exactly do you know that?

say:0:1321504001:0.text: That's all the ingredients we need! Let's find a place in town where we can brew the potion.
say:0:1321504001:0.source_cn: 需要的药草都采到了，镇上应该有地方可以炼药。

say:1:1321505001:0.text: Look, there's a crucible right here! I was right to remember this spot.
say:1:1321505001:0.source_cn: 这里就有一口坩埚可以炼药呢，我记的果然没错。

say:0:1321506001:0.text: Voila! It's done! Let's give it to Gali!
say:0:1321506001:0.source_cn: 药剂做好啦，带回去交给伽利吧！
say:0:1321506001:0.male: Voila! It's done! Let's give it to Gali!
say:0:1321506001:0.female: Voila! It's done! Let's give it to Gali!

say:3:1321507001:0.text: Gali! We've got the anti-allergy potion ready for you! Drink this, and you'll feel better in no time!
say:3:1321507001:0.source_cn: 伽利，这瓶特效药给你。服用它以后，你的过敏症状就能得到...

say:5:1321507003:0.text: Oh, poor Gali, your tongue is swelling up more...
say:5:1321507003:0.source_cn: 呃，伽利，你的舌头肿得越来越厉害了……

say:6:1321507004:0.text: Magister, if you hadn't returned when you did, I was about to drag Gali back to town myself!
say:6:1321507004:0.male: Magister, if you hadn't returned when you did, I was about to drag Gali back to town myself!
say:6:1321507004:0.female: Magister, if you hadn't returned when you did, I was about to drag Gali back to town myself!

say:7:1321507005:0.text: Don't worry, Melissa. Gali should be fine for now.
say:7:1321507005:0.source_cn: 放心吧，梅丽莎。伽利暂时不会再过敏了。

say:8:1321507006:0.text: But the potion only works for a limited time, so it's best not to stay here too long.
say:8:1321507006:0.source_cn: 不过这瓶药的药效只能持续一段时间，你们还是不要在花海里...

say:9:1321507007:0.text: What?! We need to hurry up and start the investigation then!
say:9:1321507007:0.source_cn: 什么？！那我们快点开始考察吧！

say:10:1321507008:0.text: Wow, this potion is truly magical! You seem fine now!
say:10:1321507008:0.source_cn: 你才刚喝了药……现在就没事了吗？！

say:11:1321507009:0.text: My nose and throat aren't itchy anymore, and I can speak perfectly fine now!
say:11:1321507009:0.source_cn: 比刚才好多了！至少鼻子和喉咙不痒了，舌头也开始消肿了！

say:12:1321507010:0.text: We've got to take advantage of the time when I'm not allergic!
say:12:1321507010:0.source_cn: 我们得抓紧我不过敏的这段时间才行！

say:16:1321507012:0.text: Magister, let's stick around nearby. That way, if Gali runs into trouble again, we can help right away!
say:16:1321507012:0.source_cn: 主人，那我们就在附近随便逛逛吧。万一伽利再出什么事，我...

say:16:1321507012:0.female: Magister, let's stick around nearby. That way, if Gali runs into trouble again, we can help right away!

say:3:1321508002:0.text: I'm a little worried about him too, considering how stubborn he is...
say:3:1321508002:0.source_cn: 其实我也有点担心，毕竟伽利的性格很固执……

choice_prompt:4:1321508002.text: I'm a little worried about him too, considering how stubborn he is...
choice_prompt:4:1321508002.source_cn: 其实我也有点担心，毕竟伽利的性格很固执……

say:5:1321508004:0.text: How about we <style="highlight">wait here until evening</style>? If Gali hasn't left the Petalia Plains by then, we can go check on him.

say:6:1321508005:0.text: I hope the allergy potion still works by then!
say:6:1321508005:0.source_cn: 但愿到晚上的时候，过敏药还没有失效！

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 我和你们有一样的担忧

choice:4:1:2.text: Melissa won't just leave him be.
choice:4:1:2.male: Melissa won't just leave him be.
choice:4:1:2.female: Melissa won't just leave him be.

say:8:1321508003:0.text: Knowing Gali, he'll probably just sneak back!
say:8:1321508003:0.source_cn: 以伽利的性格，恐怕他会再跑回来的！
say:8:1321508003:0.male: Knowing Gali, he'll probably just sneak back!
say:8:1321508003:0.female: Knowing Gali, he'll probably just sneak back!

choice:4:2:3.male: Should I drag him to town now?
choice:4:2:3.female: Should I drag him to town now?

say:0:1321508101:0.source_cn: 去找梅丽莎和伽利看看吧。
say:0:1321508101:0.male: Let's go check on Gali and Melissa.
say:0:1321508101:0.female: Let's go check on Gali and Melissa.

say:1:1321508102:0.source_cn: 希望过敏药的效果还没消失……

say:0:1321511001:0.text: What's with these guards and their lack of courtesy?! Thankfully, that one there actually had some sense and recognized <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:0:1321511001:0.source_cn: 这些雇佣兵太没礼貌了！还好那位士兵认识<style=s...
say:0:1321511001:0.male: What's with these guards and their lack of courtesy?! Thankfully, that one there actually had some sense and recognized <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:0:1321511001:0.female: What's with these guards and their lack of courtesy?! Thankfully, that one there actually had some sense and recognized <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:1:1321511002:0.text: Let's have a word with him and ask why they're after Melissa and Gali.
say:1:1321511002:0.source_cn: 我们去和他谈谈吧，问问那些雇佣兵为什么要抓梅丽莎和伽利。
say:1:1321511002:0.male: Let's have a word with him and ask why they're after Melissa and Gali.
say:1:1321511002:0.female: Let's have a word with him and ask why they're after Melissa and Gali.

say:4:1321513002:0.text: Captain, these two are definitely up to no good! They've been lurking around the ruins for who knows how long!
say:4:1321513002:0.source_cn: 队长，这俩人天黑了还不回家，一直在遗迹附近鬼鬼祟祟的，...

say:5:1321513003:1.text: If I hadn't heard them sneezing with my sharp ears, these tomb raiders would've slipped through!
say:5:1321513003:1.source_cn: 要不是我耳朵尖，听见了打喷嚏的声音，还真把这两个盗墓贼...

say:6:1321513004:0.text: Oh my, I've said the same thing over sixteen times! Gali and I are scholars from the Evergreen Conservatory! We're here for archaeology, not tomb raiding!
say:6:1321513004:0.source_cn: 我已经重申十六遍了！我和伽利是冬青学会的学者！我们是在...

say:7:1321513005:1.text: Hmph, don't try to fool me! I saw you digging up the tombs and taking things from the dead!
say:7:1321513005:1.source_cn: 什么考古，净找借口！偷偷摸摸刨土，挖别人的坟，拿死人的...

say:10:1321513006:0.text: Don't slander us like that! We have a very strict set of procedures! We don't damage the tombs; all we do is document everything carefully and preserve the artifacts for future study!
say:10:1321513006:0.source_cn: 那不一样！考古有一套严格的方法和程序，绝对不会对墓葬造...

say:11:1321513007:0.text: Come on! There's a world of difference between archaeology and tomb raiding!
say:11:1321513007:0.source_cn: 这和盗墓完全不同！你别想污蔑我们！

say:12:1321513008:1.text: You can say whatever you like, but who knows what dirty deeds you're hiding?
say:12:1321513008:1.source_cn: 嗬，挖死人的墓还有理了？你们说的那么好听，谁知道背地里...

say:15:1321513011:1.text: I don't know anything about archaeology, but if you've got any official paper from the Duchy, show it to me.
say:15:1321513011:1.source_cn: 我没听说过什么考古。你们有公国的许可吗？

say:17:1321513013:1.text: Then you can't just take things from the ancient tombs! According to the law, I have to take you back to town, and someone there will determine whether you're guilty or not.
say:17:1321513013:1.source_cn: 没有许可，怎么能私自拿走古墓里的东西！你们自己刚才不是...

say:20:1321513014:0.text: W-wait, the Evergreen Conservatory is recognized by the Empire! We don't need any paper for archaeology!
say:20:1321513014:0.source_cn: 等等，冬青学会是帝国特许的组织！我们考古不需要申请许可！

say:21:1321513015:0.text: Quit making excuses! If this so-called conservatory was that well-known, I would've heard of it by now! It's probably just something you made up!
say:21:1321513015:0.source_cn: 别扯了！要是这什么学会真有这么厉害，我怎么可能没听说过...

say:22:1321513016:0.text: It's not our fault you haven't heard of it!
say:22:1321513016:0.source_cn: 你没听说过是你的问题，怎么能怪到我们身上？

say:25:1321513017:0.text: Exactly! The magister can vouch for us!
say:25:1321513017:0.source_cn: 就是！魔法师大人可以给我们作证！
say:25:1321513017:0.male: Exactly! The magister can vouch for us!
say:25:1321513017:0.female: Exactly! The magister can vouch for us!

say:34:1321513022:1.source_cn: 繁花原野的不少遗迹都遭到了他们的破坏，还有不少古物流进...

say:35:1321513023:1.text: These tomb raiders are slick. They never peddle their stolen goods in crowded areas. Instead, they target tourists, claiming to have "found" the items and selling them for some money.
say:35:1321513023:1.source_cn: 而且这些盗墓贼非常狡猾，他们从不在人多眼杂的地方出手盗...

say:39:1321513027:0.source_cn: 那你们也不能随便抓人啊。要不是魔法师大人刚好过来，我和...

say:40:1321513028:0.text: As long as you two leave the Petalia Plains and stop digging up ancient artifacts, the misunderstanding will be resolved.
say:40:1321513028:0.source_cn: 只要两位离开繁花原野，不在这里盗掘古物，误会自然会消除。

say:43:1321513029:0.source_cn: 不是盗掘！是保护性挖掘！

say:44:1321513030:1.text: As scholars, it's our job to safeguard the ruins! What if the tomb raiders come back and steal more artifacts?

say:45:1321513031:1.text: Sir, I'm asking you to leave for your own good.

say:46:1321513032:0.text: But leaving now could cause irreparable damage to the ruins and artifacts!
say:46:1321513032:0.source_cn: 但这有可能会造成遗迹和文物的损毁，这种损失是无法计量的！

say:0:1321519001:0.female: That's the guy! He's the one who sold us the bracelet!

choice_prompt:12:1321520007.text: Uh... Melissa... she... well... hmmm... ACHOO!

choice:6:1:2.female: Who do you think is buried here?

say:9:1321525005:0.text: It's to the south, right in the <style="highlight">center of the ruins</style>... After we took the stuff, we covered it back up with dirt!

say:10:1321525006:0.text: Gali! Grab the tools. We need to rescue whatever artifacts are still there!
say:10:1321525006:0.source_cn: 伽利！快拿上工具，我们先去抢救剩下的那些文物！

say:16:1321525008:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we go too? Maybe we can help Gali and Melissa.
say:16:1321525008:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we go too? Maybe we can help Gali and Melissa.
say:16:1321525008:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we go too? Maybe we can help Gali and Melissa.

say:0:1321526001:0.text: Those two get so into it whenever archaeology's involved.
say:0:1321526001:0.source_cn: 一涉及到考古工作，伽利和梅丽莎就会变得很积极呢。

say:1:1321526002:0.text: Heh, what else do you expect?
say:1:1321526002:0.source_cn: 毕竟他们是专业的考古学家嘛~

say:0:1321528001:0.text: Looks like Melissa and Gali are going to be at this for a while...
say:0:1321528001:0.source_cn: 唔，看起来梅丽莎和伽利还要忙上好一阵呢……
say:0:1321528001:0.male: Looks like Melissa and Gali are going to be at this for a while...
say:0:1321528001:0.female: Looks like Melissa and Gali are going to be at this for a while...

say:1:1321528002:0.text: Let's leave them to it and wait over there until noon.
say:1:1321528002:0.source_cn: 还是不要打扰他们了，先在旁边等到正午吧。
say:1:1321528002:0.male: Let's leave them to it and wait over there until noon.
say:1:1321528002:0.female: Let's leave them to it and wait over there until noon.

say:3:1321529001:0.text: Melissa, how's the state of the tomb? Any artifacts left?
say:3:1321529001:0.source_cn: 梅丽莎，墓穴里的情况还好吗？留下的文物多吗？

say:4:1321529002:0.text: It's awful... Those despicable tomb raiders took everything!
say:4:1321529002:0.source_cn: 不好……一点也不好！墓穴里的东西都被盗墓贼抢劫一空了……！

say:5:1321529003:0.text: They ruined such a precious site just to make a quick profit... It's infuriating!
say:5:1321529003:0.source_cn: 为了赚钱，居然将珍贵的遗迹破坏成现在这副惨烈的模样……...

say:7:1321529005:0.text: But look at this—we did manage to salvage a piece of history.
say:7:1321529005:0.source_cn: 所幸这一趟也不算是完全没有收获。

say:8:1321529006:1.text: This small stone tablet holds immense historical value!
say:8:1321529006:1.source_cn: 你们看，我们找到了一块非常有历史价值的小石板！

choice_prompt:9:1321529006.text: This small stone tablet holds immense historical value!
choice_prompt:9:1321529006.source_cn: 你们看，我们找到了一块非常有历史价值的小石板！

say:10:1321529007:0.text: It records the legend of the Petalia Plains' sea of flowers!
say:10:1321529007:0.source_cn: 没错！这是一块记载着繁花原野的花海传说的石板！
say:10:1321529007:0.male: It records the legend of the Petalia Plains' sea of flowers!
say:10:1321529007:0.female: It records the legend of the Petalia Plains' sea of flowers!

say:13:1321529009:0.text: The legend of the sea of flowers?

say:14:1321529010:0.text: Mmhmm. The stone tablet says these flowers bloom year-round despite the cold because the land is soaked with the blood of soldiers who sacrificed their lives.
say:14:1321529010:0.source_cn: 是啊。石板上说，这片原野上的花之所以能在白山公国这么寒...

say:15:1321529011:0.text: Their blood nourished the soil, and their brave, noble spirits fused with this land.
say:15:1321529011:0.source_cn: 不但他们的鲜血浇灌了这片土地，连他们英勇的灵魂也融入了这里！

say:16:1321529012:0.text: Each sapphirine blossom represents a soldier's soul, embodying their unyielding will. Since their souls are eternal, these flowers never wither.
say:16:1321529012:0.source_cn: 原野上每一朵六瓣的蓝绒花，都是一位战士的灵魂的象征，是...

say:17:1321529013:0.text: Preserved artifacts are undoubtedly precious, but this stone tablet uncovers a forgotten part of history and is just as valuable as any bracelet or amulet!
say:17:1321529013:0.source_cn: 保存至今的古物固然可贵，但这块石板揭露了一段失落的历史...

say:18:1321529014:0.text: The tomb raiders probably ignored it because it was so old, and the legend was written in ancient script, making it look worthless.
say:18:1321529014:0.source_cn: 我猜，就是因为这块石板太过破旧，上面的传说又是用古代文...

say:19:1321529015:0.text: If Gali hadn't recognized those characters, we might've missed it too.
say:19:1321529015:0.source_cn: 如果不是伽利认出了那些字，很可能我们也会错过它。

say:20:1321529016:0.text: It's amazing that such a tiny stone tablet contains such significant history!
say:20:1321529016:0.source_cn: 原来是这样……幸好是你们发现了这块石板！

say:21:1321529017:0.text: Let's get this stone tablet to the guard captain quickly so he can pass it to the duchy for proper safekeeping!
say:21:1321529017:0.source_cn: 对了，我们得尽快把这块石板交给卫队长，让他上交给公国，...

say:23:1321529008:0.text: Don't underestimate this stone tablet. It records the legend of the Petalia Plains' sea of flowers!
say:23:1321529008:0.source_cn: 别小看了这块石板，上面可是记载着繁花原野这片花海的重要传说！
say:23:1321529008:0.male: Don't underestimate this stone tablet. It records the legend of the Petalia Plains' sea of flowers!
say:23:1321529008:0.female: Don't underestimate this stone tablet. It records the legend of the Petalia Plains' sea of flowers!

choice:9:1:2.text: What value could a stone tablet have?
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 石板能有什么历史价值？
choice:9:1:2.male: What value could a stone tablet have?
choice:9:1:2.female: What value could a stone tablet have?

say:3:1321531001:0.text: I heard what you were saying just now, and I had no idea that the sapphirine blossom held such deep significance.
say:3:1321531001:0.source_cn: 你们刚刚说的话我都听见了，没想到六瓣蓝绒花居然还有这样...

say:4:1321531002:1.text: No wonder it blooms so vibrantly in the cold... the spirits of the soldiers must be watching over everyone in this land.
say:4:1321531002:1.source_cn: 难怪在白山公国这样寒冷的地方，繁花原野的六瓣蓝绒花还能...

say:5:1321531003:1.text: Now I understand the real value of archaeology.
say:5:1321531003:1.source_cn: 两位，我现在终于明白了你们所说的“考古”的意义。这和盗...

say:6:1321531004:1.text: Unlike tomb raiders who dig for money, you uncover history and reveal untold stories.
say:6:1321531004:1.source_cn: 同样是挖开坟墓，盗墓贼是为了倒卖文物，但考古却是为了研...

say:7:1321531005:1.text: If it hadn't been for you, the story of these sapphirine blossoms might've been lost forever, and the blood of our ancestors would have been in vain.
say:7:1321531005:1.source_cn: 唉，是啊……要不是你们，这些蓝绒花的故事恐怕永远都不会...

say:8:1321531006:0.text: Well, that's what sets archaeology apart from tomb raiding!
say:8:1321531006:0.source_cn: 没错，这就是盗墓和考古的区别！

say:9:1321531007:0.text: To archaeologists, even the smallest, most overlooked item can hold great value. Artifacts with inscriptions and drawings are the most genuine storytellers of history!
say:9:1321531007:0.source_cn: 除了金银珠宝，每一件藏在角落里毫不起眼的东西，对考古学...

say:10:1321531008:0.text: Preserving them and sharing their stories helps history live on. That's what archaeology is all about.
say:10:1321531008:0.source_cn: 将它们保护起来，把它们所象征的故事公之于众，让历史不断...

say:11:1321531009:1.text: I'm sorry for mistaking you for tomb raiders before.
say:11:1321531009:1.source_cn: 非常抱歉，之前误解了两位。

say:12:1321531010:1.text: When I go back, I'll make sure to teach my men to respect scholars like you who come to study history.
say:12:1321531010:1.source_cn: 等我回去后，一定会教训手下的卫兵和雇佣兵，让他们尊重各...

say:13:1321531011:0.text: *Sigh* I'm sorry for being so rude earlier...
say:13:1321531011:0.source_cn: 唉……之前的事真是对不住。

say:14:1321531012:0.text: But don't worry, I won't mix up archaeologists and tomb raiders again!
say:14:1321531012:0.source_cn: 不过你们放心，我以后肯定不会再把考古学家和盗墓贼弄混了！

say:15:1321531013:0.text: Well, it's not a big deal. Being misunderstood is part of the difficult path of archaeology.
say:15:1321531013:0.source_cn: 算了，也没什么大不了的。在考古这条艰难的求索之路上，被...

say:16:1321531014:1.text: As you said, this stone tablet is priceless to the Duchy of Whiteridge. I'll arrange for it to be taken to Cedartown, where experts will safeguard it and share its story with everyone.
say:16:1321531014:1.source_cn: 正如两位学者所说，这快石板对白山公国的意义无可比拟。我...

say:19:1321531015:0.text: Thank you, Captain. This is exactly what we hoped for!
say:19:1321531015:0.source_cn: 谢谢您，卫队长，这正是我们希望看到的！

say:20:1321531016:1.text: You two are welcome to stay here and continue your work on these ruins. I'll report to Captain Rodrigo and make sure he arranges everything you need for your stay.
say:20:1321531016:1.source_cn: 如果不介意的话，两位学者也可以留在白山公国，对这里的遗...

say:21:1321531017:0.text: Thank you, but we need to think it over and get approval from the conservatory first.
say:21:1321531017:0.source_cn: 这个嘛……我们需要考虑一下，也得征求学会的同意才行。

say:22:1321531018:0.text: Regardless of whether we stay or not, as long as more people understand the importance of archaeology, our efforts will have been worthwhile... ACHOO!
say:22:1321531018:0.source_cn: 无论能不能留下来，只要有越来越多的人能理解考古这份工作...

say:23:1321531019:0.text: Oh no, Gali, you're sneezing again! You really need to get out of this field of flowers soon!
say:23:1321531019:0.source_cn: ……伽利，你又开始过敏了！还是赶快离开这片花海吧！

say:24:1321531020:0.text: ...I'm fine. Besides, pollen allergies aren't always a bad thing!
say:24:1321531020:0.source_cn: 唔……我没事的。再说花粉过敏也不全是坏事！

say:25:1321531021:0.text: If it weren't for my allergies, the guard wouldn't have found us, let alone caught the tomb raiders and found the stone tablet with the flower sea legend!
say:25:1321531021:0.source_cn: 要不是因为我的花粉过敏，雇佣兵大哥也没办法发现我们，更...

say:26:1321531022:0.text: Maybe the spirits of the soldiers are helping us in their own way... achoo!
say:26:1321531022:0.source_cn: 或许这也是战士们的灵魂给予我们的一种帮助……阿嚏！！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1321509003:.source_cn: 少来这套！抓的就是你们！

subtitle:1:1321524001:.text: The evening settled in, and the sky grew darker...
subtitle:1:1321524001:.source_cn: 过了一段时间，天色渐渐黑了下来……
